verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents deploying apps to chosen regions worldwide and to multiple regions with a single command, so placement is user-controlled at the compute level. The evidence never ties that choice to where data itself is stored (Volumes, Managed Postgres, Sprite disks) or to any residency commitment. Missing for 10: explicit region selection for volumes/databases, documented data-residency or compliance guarantees, independent corroboration.
